confidence_gate.strength: mean combined z-score of the five highest combined-score ETFs
confidence_gate.threshold: strictly above the expanding prior-week 60th percentile
confidence_gate.factor_agreement: at least three of the selected five ETFs have positive z-scores for both best_002 and original_001

risk_gate.trend: SPY adjusted close strictly above its trailing 200-session mean at the factor observation date
risk_gate.volatility: SPY trailing-20-session volatility no greater than the expanding prior-week 80th percentile

timing.factor_observation: latest completed market session on or before the prior weekly decision

costs.underlying_sleeves: matching-cost core and buffered-factor net returns
costs.top_level_allocation_turnover: absolute change from drifted factor-sleeve weight

controls.shuffled_confidence: fixed permutation of confidence states combined with the original risk gate
controls.inverted_risk: original confidence gate combined with the complement of the risk gate

promotion_gates.primary: 50-bps annual return and Sharpe strictly exceed matching core and drawdown is no worse
promotion_gates.stress: 100-bps annual return and Sharpe are no worse than matching core
promotion_gates.later_windows: 50-bps excess annual return over matching core is positive in both later windows
promotion_gates.controls: 50-bps Sharpe strictly exceeds always-on, shuffled-confidence, and inverted-risk controls
promotion_gates.uncertainty: familywise paired Sharpe lower bound versus core is positive
promotion_gates.activation: active-week share remains within the predeclared range
